purpose: Preserve the historical JANUS Slime lineages supplied by the operator, connect them to already canonical Slime mechanisms, and define the minimum evidence-bound contract for an ideal Slime memory organ inside the JANUS Activator.

tier_A_direct_canonical_sources.use: Activation authority, freshness, epistemic, effect and receipt boundaries.
MicroGPTSlime -> quantized descendant lineage and parameter-usefulness/precision allocation operator.
Verified-episode M2R memory, Slime teacher/student split, top-k advisory routing, exact verification after prediction.
Content-inspected Golden Slime ancestry, curriculum/arena salvage, and explicit rejection of heuristic score as proof.

source_evidence.tier_B_boundary: Current runtime can parse RAR5 headers and compute archive digests, but has no working RAR5 decompressor. Therefore archive filenames, sizes and lineage density are admissible provenance signals; unextracted source bodies are not treated as inspected code.
source_evidence.tier_C_inference_rule: Filename-derived mechanisms are CANDIDATE_DONORS until matched to extracted code, independent canonical source, tests, or replay receipts.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Small reusable memory/adaptation nucleus shared by multiple JANUS organs.
lineage_map.promotion: Retain as interface ancestry; do not assume all copies are semantically identical without digest/content comparison.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Historical attempts to make Slime platform-independent, reality-checked and resistant to brittle identity coupling.
lineage_map.promotion: Names are provenance only. Reality-check and anti-brittleness principles may be promoted; exact Override/Tie semantics require source extraction and adversarial tests.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Consolidation/maintenance while no fresh activation is being processed.
lineage_map.promotion: Allowed only if idle work cannot manufacture FRESH_TRIGGER, evidence, authorization or external effect.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Route-value traces that bias future candidate ordering from prior verified episodes.
lineage_map.promotion: Pheromone may rank routes but cannot certify a claim; reinforcement must bind to receipts and support decay/correction.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Champion/challenger learning, curriculum and preservation of strong strategies.
lineage_map.promotion: Only verified receipts can create a champion. Historical P=NP-style theorem promotion is explicitly rejected.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Persistent event curriculum and route-map learning over progressively harder frozen gates.
lineage_map.promotion: Train/validation/holdout split must prevent trajectory leakage and preserve negative/UNKNOWN episodes.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Full-capacity teacher plus quantized/local student, preserving usefulness traces while reducing deployment cost.
lineage_map.promotion: Student deployment requires frozen holdout parity thresholds and exact downstream verification.

lineage_map.candidate_role: Long-running online adaptation with persistent state and event logs.
lineage_map.promotion: Treat as experimental online-learning ancestry. Any tachyon/quantum terminology has zero physics authority unless separately evidenced.

placement_in_activation_loop: after LOAD_PROVENANCE_AND_STATE: retrieve structurally similar verified episodes
before GENERATE_BOUNDED_CANDIDATES / route selection: propose top-k routes and expected failure modes
after exact verification and receipt finalization: append learning episode and update route traces
during idle only: consolidate summaries/weights without generating a new activation

memory_planes.episodic_receipt_memory: Immutable activation episode keyed by source digest, state-before, route, result, verifier/receipt digest and charged resource outcome.
memory_planes.pheromone_route_memory: Decaying route preference derived only from admissible receipts; success reinforces, bounded failure/RESOURCE_LIMIT can inhibit or redirect, UNKNOWN is preserved as UNKNOWN.
memory_planes.curriculum_memory: Frozen families of activation scenarios with fingerprint-isolated train/validation/holdout partitions.
memory_planes.counterexample_and_failure_memory: Failed, corrupt, blocked, conflicting and unresolved episodes remain searchable; correction supersedes but does not delete ancestry.
memory_planes.structural_usefulness_memory: Track which features/parameters/routes were actually useful; prune weak structure and spend precision where verified traces are high.

teacher_student.teacher: Full non-quantized Slime on NAS/CI/lab over verified episodes.
teacher_student.student: Quantized/local scout for retrieval and route ranking.
student_promotion_gate: deterministic replay for same frozen inputs where required

allowed: deduplicate equivalent memory references without deleting ancestry
prepare candidate hypotheses for the next fresh trigger

integrity_and_antibrittleness.hash_non_use: Hashes must not act as magic semantic identity, truth, permission or selection authority.

selection_verdict.ideal_slime_is: a compositional memory organ built from verified receipt memory + pheromone routing + curriculum + teacher/student compression + idle consolidation, all subordinate to the existing Activator constitution and exact gates
highest_value_donors_now: M2R exact episode memory and top-k route ranking
Golden-Slime arena only as champion/challenger heuristic with verifier authority external
Absolute Idle Slime as consolidation mode

integration_plan.phase_0: Register this lineage and authority ceiling in meta-registry.
integration_plan.phase_1: Add a non-executable SLIME_MEMORY_LINK in Hawkar-usls/Hawkar-usls::.janus/activator pointing here.
integration_plan.phase_2: When RAR5 source extraction is available, hash and AST/test every candidate donor and replace filename inference with content-grounded mechanism receipts.
integration_plan.phase_3: Implement JANUS_ACTIVATOR_SLIME_MEMORY_R0 behind the existing Activator route/receipt boundary.
integration_plan.phase_4: Adversarially test stale-trigger injection, self-output replay, invalid receipt poisoning, route lock-in, hash collision/renaming, timeout-to-negative mutation, and teacher/student divergence.
integration_plan.promotion_gate: No runtime promotion until clean fresh-trigger -> route proposal -> exact verifier -> persistent receipt -> fresh-checkout replay remains PASS with Slime enabled and disabled controls.
